scope: 七大主题长难句精读（自编仿真练习，非历年真题原句）

items.title: 教育机会与社会流动
items.sentence: Although access to higher education has expanded considerably over the past decade, the extent to which family income continues to shape students' choices remains a matter of debate.
items.translation: 尽管过去十年接受高等教育的机会大幅扩大，但家庭收入在多大程度上仍影响学生的选择，依然存在争议。
items.structure: Although 引导让步状语从句；主句主语为 the extent；to which 引导定语从句修饰 extent；remains 为系动词。
items.focus: access to；the extent to which；remain a matter of debate

items.title: 技术进步与公共利益
items.sentence: What makes the rapid adoption of artificial intelligence particularly controversial is not simply the possibility of replacing routine tasks, but the difficulty of determining who should be accountable for its consequences.
items.translation: 人工智能迅速普及之所以尤其具有争议，并不只是因为它可能取代常规工作，还因为难以确定谁应对其后果负责。
items.structure: What 引导主语从句；is 后接 not simply...but... 并列表语；of replacing 为介词后动名词；who 引导宾语从句。
items.focus: What 主语从句；not simply...but...；be accountable for

items.title: 市场机制与不平等
items.sentence: Rather than assuming that economic growth will automatically benefit every member of society, policy makers need to examine how income is distributed and whether public services reach those who need them most.
items.translation: 政策制定者不应想当然地认为经济增长会自动惠及社会每个成员，而应考察收入如何分配，以及公共服务能否惠及最需要它们的人。
items.structure: Rather than + doing 作状语；that 引导宾语从句；how 与 whether 分别引导 examine 的宾语从句；who 引导定语从句。

items.title: 公共政策与群体差异
items.sentence: Policies designed to improve public welfare are unlikely to succeed unless they take into account the different circumstances under which individuals live and work.
items.translation: 旨在改善公共福利的政策不太可能取得成功，除非它们考虑到个人生活和工作的不同处境。
items.structure: 过去分词短语 designed... 作后置定语；unless 引导条件状语从句；under which 引导定语从句。
items.focus: be designed to；take into account；under which

items.title: 环境保护与长期成本
items.sentence: Measures that appear expensive in the short term may prove economical in the long run if the environmental costs they prevent are taken into consideration.
items.translation: 如果把这些措施所避免的环境成本考虑在内，那么短期看似昂贵的措施从长远看可能反而更经济。
items.structure: that 引导定语从句；they prevent 为省略关系代词的定语从句；if 引导条件状语从句；they prevent 修饰 costs。
items.focus: in the short term；in the long run；take into consideration

items.title: 认知偏差与判断
items.sentence: Because people tend to pay greater attention to information that confirms their existing beliefs, they may fail to recognize evidence that challenges the assumptions on which their decisions are based.
items.translation: 由于人们往往更关注能够证实既有信念的信息，他们可能无法识别那些挑战其决策所依据假设的证据。
items.structure: Because 引导原因状语从句；两个 that 分别引导定语从句；on which 引导定语从句修饰 assumptions。

items.title: 法律制度与社会信任
items.sentence: When public institutions are expected to enforce rules consistently, citizens are more likely to accept decisions, even when those decisions do not serve their immediate interests.
items.translation: 当公共机构被期待始终如一地执行规则时，公民更有可能接受相关决定，即使这些决定并不符合他们眼前的利益。
items.structure: When 引导时间/条件状语从句；are expected to 为被动结构；even when 引导让步状语从句。
items.focus: be expected to；enforce rules；be likely to；serve interests
